en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The main goal of this subject is obtaining knowledge of construction and technology manufacturing sitting upholstery furniture. The other parts of this subject is notify of producing structural materials and supplies, their processing by machine-technological equipments. This subject is also informing about creation material compositions and technical adjustment of manufacturing. Course content: 1. Special machinery and technological equipment. (allowance 4/4) a. Machinery equipment. b. The relationship of machinery to technology. c. Semester work. 2. Materials for the production of upholstered furniture. (allowance 8/8) a. Materials for classical technology b. Materials for contemporary technology c. Technological restrictions on use of materials for upholstered furniture 3. Materials for the production of upholstered furniture. (allowance 8/4) a. Technology of production of upholstered product. b. Classic upholstery technology. c. Contemporary upholstery technology. d. Relationship upholstery - supporting frame. e. Production technology of coatings 4. Technological process modeling of upholstered furniture (allowance 4/3) a. Model - prototype - product. 5. Production of upholstered products. (allowance 4/5) a. Industrial production of small series. b. Industrial production of large series. c. Individual custom production. d. Economic aspects of production of upholstered furniture. 6. Presentation of semester works. (allowance 0/4)
